item.title: [+1] Sensex soars 1,233 points to 75,692.78 and Nifty 1.68% to 23,440.80 as oil slides on Iran diplomacy
item.description:
Third straight gain; oil & gas and metal indices led while tech and media lagged. Nifty closed above its 50-day average. Builds on last week's recovery.

Metals, cement & chemicals: mild tailwind (+1) — Metals rallied

Why it matters: Falling crude and peace hopes cut India's biggest macro risk, lifting rate-sensitive and oil-consuming sectors and drawing foreign buyers back.

Market gauges: Equities (Nifty & Sensex) +2

Confidence: high · horizon: days

item.title: [+1] Brent plunges 7.63% to $104.77, its biggest drop in months, as Iran opens the door to talks
item.description:
WTI fell 7.36% to $96.46. Down from a six-month high of $117.64 on Friday. Reversing October's surge; strike risk after the 3 November US vote remains.

Metals, cement & chemicals: mild tailwind (+1) — Cheaper inputs

Why it matters: A $13 drop in three sessions sharply cuts India's import bill, fuel-subsidy risk and inflation pressure, easing the rupee and bond yields.

Market gauges: Fiscal & trade balance +2, Inflation outlook +2

Confidence: high · horizon: days
